messages:
alex: Quick random Q — if you could teach one unusual skill to your future home robot assistant, what would it be? (not just 'vacuum' or 'make coffee')

maria: Fold fitted sheets perfectly. I've tried to teach humans, failed. :cry:

tomas: Be able to detect when I'm low-energy and make me a playlist + dim lights. Emotional but practical.

ivy: Detect and politely remove spoilers from my feeds. 10/10.

jen: Translate barks/meows into 'short human sentences'. I'd pay $$$.

alex: Ooh love the pet-translator idea.

maria: Also: Tetris-level dishwasher loading algorithm. Emptying would still be my job though. :sweat_smile:

tomas: Teach it to perform triage on laundry stains — decide wash temp + pre-treat type.

ivy: Teach it to social small talk so it can be the 'friend' you pretend to have over during awkward family dinners. :joy:

jen: ops-bot: poll — options: fold-fitted-sheets, playlist-dimmer, pet-translator, spoiler-filter, dishwasher-tetris, laundry-stain-expert, smalltalk-buddy

ops-bot: Poll created. Vote with reactions. (This is a mock poll — pls react with :one: :two: etc.)

alex: I'm going pet-translator > fitted sheets > dishwasher.

maria: voted :two: (fitted sheets) — it's a trauma thing.

tomas: :three: playlist-dimmer

ivy: :four: spoiler-filter

jen: Anyone else imagine the robot writing bedtime stories from your browsing history? :laughing:

maria: That would be terrifyingly accurate.

alex: ok final thought — bonus skill: ability to emotionally support you during deploys. uninstall panic.

tomas: true value prop.
